_about: M3 v3 product media (media agent, 2026-10-10; fixer pass same day). Files live in prototypes/media/m3/v3/. use: wall = hero wall tile 1200x750; card = product-card tab 1920x1200; loop = H.264 MP4 1280x800 (AV1 twin in "av1", WebP poster in "poster"); still = high-res still of a loop's end state (same view as its poster), not a separate tab; mobile = 4:3 single tile 1200x900; cutout = transparent RGBA WebP for compositing. Captions are provenance labels. Yisbir panels are design concepts with sample data; full Figma boards stay internal until permission.
